basic.name: Healing Brew
basic.description: Heal the lowest Health allied Hero within 6 range for 210~~0.04~~ Health.

basic.name: Cloud Serpent
basic.description: Summon a Cloud Serpent on an allied Hero that attacks nearby enemies every second. Each attack deals 26~~0.04~~ damage and heals the ally for 20~~0.04~~. Lasts for 8 seconds.

basic.name: Blinding Wind
basic.description: Throw a cloud of wind at the 2 nearest enemies (prioritizing Heroes), dealing 133~~0.04~~ damage. Heroes hit are Blinded and Slowed by 15% for 1.5 seconds.

heroic.name: Jug of 1,000 Cups
heroic.description: Channel for up to 6 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds, increase the cooldown of Jug of 1,000 Cups by 2 seconds, up to 50 additional seconds, and heal the lowest Health nearby allied Hero for 75~~0.04~~ Health.

heroic.name: Water Dragon
heroic.description: Li Li channels for 2 seconds, summoning a Water Dragon that hits the nearest enemy Hero within 12 range and all enemies near them, dealing 300~~0.04~~ damage and slowing their Movement Speed by 70% for 4 seconds.

trait.name: Fast Feet
trait.description: Upon taking damage, your Basic Ability cooldowns refresh 50% faster and you gain 10% Movement Speed for 1 second.

trait.name: Fast Feet
trait.description: Upon taking damage, your Basic Ability cooldowns refresh 50% faster and you gain 10% Movement Speed for 1 second.

activable.name: Let's Go!
activable.description:
Activate to heal an allied Hero for 160~~0.04~~ and make them Unstoppable for 1 second. Let's Go's cooldown is affected by Fast Feet.

Cannot be used on Li Li.

activable.name: Mistweaver
activable.description: Activate to heal nearby allied Heroes for 149~~0.04~~. Basic Attacks and Cloud Serpent attacks reduce the cooldown of Mistweaver by 1 second.

level1.name: Free Drinks
level1.description: When Healing Brew heals a Hero under 50% Health, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is refunded.

level1.name: Serpent Sidekick
level1.description: Cloud Serpent no longer costs Mana and while Fast Feet is active its cooldown refreshes an additional 75% faster.

level1.name: Eager Adventurer
level1.description: Increase Fast Feet's duration by 150% and increase Mana regeneration by 150% while Fast Feet is active.

level4.name: Wind Serpent
level4.description:
Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased Movement Speed. Casting Blinding Wind increases this bonus to 20% for 3 seconds. 

Passive: Cloud Serpent attacks 25% faster.

level4.name: Surging Winds
level4.description: If Blinding Wind targets 2 or more Heroes, its cooldown is instantly reduced by 2 seconds and Li Li gains 10% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

level4.name: Safety Sprint
level4.description:
Activate to gain Fast Feet, 30 Armor, and 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

Passive: While Fast Feet is active, Li Li gains 10 Armor.

level7.name: The Good Stuff
level7.description: Healing Brew heals for an additional 42~~0.04~~ over 3 seconds. While Fast Feet is active, this heal amount is increased by 100%.

level7.name: Mass Vortex
level7.description: Increase the number of enemies hit by Blinding Wind from 2 to 3. Blinding Wind deals 75% more damage when it targets 3 Heroes.

level7.name: Let's Go!
level7.description:
Activate to heal an allied Hero for 160~~0.04~~ and make them Unstoppable for 1 second. Let's Go's cooldown is affected by Fast Feet.

Cannot be used on Li Li.

level13.name: Lightning Serpent
level13.description: Cloud Serpent attacks bounce to hit 2 additional targets for 13~~0.04~~ damage and 10~~0.04~~ healing.

level13.name: Gale Force
level13.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Blind duration by 0.75 seconds. Li Li's Basic Attacks against Blinded Heroes deal 100% increased damage.

level13.name: Hindering Winds
level13.description: Increase Blinding Wind's Slow amount to 30% and its duration to 2 seconds.

level16.name: Two For One
level16.description: Increases the number of allies healed by Healing Brew to 2, but increases the cooldown by 1 second.

level16.name: Pick Me Up
level16.description: Healing Brew heals for 33% more when the target is under 50% Health.

level16.name: Blessings Of Yu’lon
level16.description: Cloud Serpent grants its bearer 10% increased healing received and heals them for an additional 0.5% of their maximum Health each time it attacks.

level20.name: Jug of 1,000,000 Cups
level20.description: Jug of 1,000 Cups heals two allies at a time.

level20.name: Double Dragon
level20.description: After hitting a target with Water Dragon, another Water Dragon is summoned at the point of impact.

level20.name: Mistweaver
level20.description: Activate to heal nearby allied Heroes for 149~~0.04~~. Basic Attacks and Cloud Serpent attacks reduce the cooldown of Mistweaver by 1 second.

level20.name: Shake It Off
level20.description:
While Stunned, Silenced, or Rooted and for 2 seconds afterwards, Li Li gains 35 Armor.

Passive: Increase Fast Feet's cooldown refresh rate to 75%.
